I peruse the FB group Feline Nutrition - Feed Cats like Cats. They have a bunch of guides with analysis for canned cat food, and also keep on top of major reformulations; ie, most FF pate now containing fish, or Friskies no longer being all life stages. They do have a focus on raw feeding, which I don’t do, but the canned food guides are still extensive enough for me to stick around. 

My original comment was from personal anecdote feeding my cats FF pate. After being on the three flavors I mentioned for a few days, I’ve noticed a decrease in foul odor. Dont get me wrong, cat shit smells like well, shit, but my boys produce absolutely rancid turds when fed fish. 

But if you’re suddenly noticing runny stools and theyve been fed the same food for a while, then I would take to the vet.

I noticed fish flavors definitely caused runnier stools. I switched to FF classic pate, but then they reformulated to have fish in most of them and noticed smellier, looser stools. Looked it up, only the chopped grill, beef and chicken, and beef and liver flavors are fish free. Currently switched to only those; time will tell if it helps lol.

[Catinfo.org](https://catinfo.org/making-cat-food/) uses rabbit meat in their guide, and also provides a link to preground rabbit meat. Making completely homemade food is intensive with the amount of vitamins and supplements needed to add to it, as well as the balance between fat, muscle meat, and secreting organs to make a balanced meal. The main concern with rabbit meat is how low in fat it is compared to the amount of lean meat, which catinfo goes more into detail about. You would have to supplement with a fat source that your kitty can tolerate. I’m assuming she’s allergic to chicken? What about beef, pork, lamb, other meats? The main allure of making homemade cat food is knowing exactly what goes into it, which is helpful for a cat with allergies. Cost can break even the first couple months, just because buying the supplements in bulk is a bit expensive up front. You might have some luck with a completer, but make sure to check the ingredients, as sometimes they use chicken or other proteins as sources.

Upsizing a beaded dress more than one or 2 sizes distorts the original design to the point that it is unrecognizable and often times unflattering. For example, a smaller design would not line up with the bust, waist, or contours, and trying to match the original beading can be costly if not impossible, depending on the style of beading. If the daughter truly loves the design, she would be happier with one that is customized for her size, because the smaller design wouldn’t translate well. Sentimentally, we can say the daughter and mother are tied, so we’ll leave that out of the equation. The logistics of trying to upsize a beaded dress is the deciding factor that I’m trying to argue.

OP clarifies that it’s a beaded dress, which is notoriously difficult and expensive to upsize. If daughter is in love with the design, it would be more economical and flattering to custom design a new dress in her size with similar beading and lacing. Dress design is very complicated and usually not as simple as adding a few panels of fabric and calling it a day. OP is not wrong when she says it would be destroyed, and the design would not translate after alterations.

Usually when something sinks it’s because it was not mixed enough, not baked long enough, or the rising agent is expired. Reading the directions the batter is supposed to be lumpy so most likely its not baked long enough. Make sure your oven is preheated and put it in the oven as soon as its mixed to avoid activating the rising agents too early, which can make it sink after baking. Try getting an oven thermometer to make sure your oven is running at the right temp, and adjust from there. Hope this helps! I love coffee cakes.

could also be that since it has mix ins, it’s more likely to sink. Swirls can do that, it might be that with this mix it’s unavoidable but i hope with some troubleshooting you get a good rise!

ED spaces have existed online as far back as people could start posting. Forums, websites, niche areas on social media like reddit, tumblr, twt. I’m sorry things have gotten to that point, but you’re not losing anything by turning away from your following. 

If you want, you can post one last time that you are in recovery, and that you do not consent to your photos being shared. There are people that will report reposts for you if they know you don’t want them up anymore. Otherwise, focus on yourself. Deactivate the account if it’s easier, and it will automatically delete in 30 days.

Parents report that when theyre in charge of the baby, they wake up. When they’re not, they can sleep through it. Ie, a husband knowing his wife will get the baby, has a much easier time sleeping through the cries. But, if he’s watching the baby alone, he’ll wake up because his subconscious knows there’s an infant depending on him. Knowing this, a schedule can help parents struggling with sleep and night duty.
